title: Bridal Bouquet — Ivory Garden
summary: A soft ivory and white bridal bouquet in a natural garden style, tailored to the couple and venue on consultation.
descriptionHtml:
A hand-tied bridal bouquet in an unstructured garden style, built around ivory and white blooms with soft green accents. We work with premium roses, garden roses, ranunculus, lisianthus and textural foliage, choosing the freshest stems available for your date so the piece photographs beautifully and holds through the ceremony and reception.

Every wedding bouquet begins with a short consultation. We refine the palette, scale and shape to suit the gown, the season and the mood of the day, so no two are alike.

  • Style: Loose, natural hand-tied garden bouquet
  • Palette: Ivory, white and soft green
  • Finish: Wrapped stems, ribbon selected with you
  • Care: Keep cool and misted until the ceremony; hand off between photos
seoDescription: Ivory and white garden-style bridal bouquet for weddings in Kingston, Jamaica. Tailored to your gown, palette and season on consultation.
careInstructions: Keep the bouquet cool, hydrated and lightly misted until the ceremony, and rest stems in water whenever it is set down.
deliveryNote: Wedding orders are scheduled and delivered to your venue by arrangement; timing confirmed during planning.
availabilityNote: Final flowers are selected for freshness on the day; seasonal substitution of similar blooms and tones may apply.

title: Bridal Bouquet — Cascading Blush
summary: A romantic cascading bridal bouquet in blush and pink tones, custom designed to the couple and venue on consultation.
descriptionHtml:
A flowing, teardrop-shaped bridal bouquet designed to cascade gently over the hands. We build it in blush and pink tones with roses, spray roses and trailing greenery, layering soft movement and depth for a timeless, romantic silhouette.

This is a made-to-order design. During your consultation we tailor the length of the cascade, the density and the exact palette to the dress and the day, so the finished bouquet feels entirely your own.

  • Style: Cascading teardrop hand-tied bouquet
  • Palette: Blush, pink and green
  • Finish: Bound stems with a ribbon chosen together
  • Care: Store cool and upright, mist lightly, rehydrate between photographs
seoDescription: Romantic cascading blush bridal bouquet, custom designed for weddings in Kingston, Jamaica. Palette and shape tailored on consultation.
careInstructions: Keep cool and upright, mist lightly and return stems to water between photos to protect the trailing greenery.
deliveryNote: Wedding orders are scheduled and delivered to your venue by arrangement; timing confirmed during planning.
availabilityNote: Final blooms are chosen for freshness on the day; seasonal substitution of similar flowers and tones may apply.

title: Bridesmaid Bouquet
summary: A coordinated hand-tied bridesmaid bouquet, scaled and colour-matched to the bridal party on consultation.
descriptionHtml:
A compact, hand-tied bouquet designed to sit beside the bridal flowers without competing with them. We keep the shape neat and easy to carry, echoing the palette and blooms of the main bouquet so the wedding party reads as one considered look in photographs.

Quantities and shades are set with you during planning. Order one to match a single attendant or several for the full party, each finished the same way for a consistent aisle.

  • Style: Rounded hand-tied posy
  • Palette: Coordinated to your bridal flowers
  • Finish: Wrapped stems with chosen ribbon
  • Care: Keep cool and hydrated until the ceremony
seoDescription: Coordinated bridesmaid bouquets for weddings in Kingston, Jamaica. Colour-matched to the bridal party, with quantities set on consultation.
careInstructions: Keep bouquets cool and standing in a little water until they are needed, and mist lightly in warm weather.
deliveryNote: Wedding orders are scheduled and delivered to your venue by arrangement; timing confirmed during planning.
availabilityNote: Final flowers are selected for freshness on the day; seasonal substitution of similar blooms and tones may apply.

title: Low Reception Centerpiece
summary: A low, lush table centerpiece for reception guests to see across, tailored to your palette and venue on consultation.
descriptionHtml:
A low, garden-style centerpiece designed to sit below the sightline so guests can talk easily across the table. We arrange it full and soft in a vessel, blending focal blooms, filler and trailing greenery for a relaxed, abundant look down the length of the reception.

Choose Classic for intimate rounds or Grand for long banquet tables and head tables. The palette and vessel are confirmed with you so the centerpieces sit naturally within your styling.

  • Style: Low, spreading garden arrangement
  • Sizes: Classic and Grand
  • Best for: Guest tables, banquet runs, head tables
  • Care: Keep out of direct sun and top up water before guests arrive
seoDescription: Low garden-style wedding centerpieces in Classic and Grand sizes for receptions in Kingston, Jamaica. Palette and vessel set on consultation.
careInstructions: Keep the centerpiece out of direct sun and away from air vents, and top up the water shortly before the reception begins.
deliveryNote: Reception flowers are delivered and set to your venue by arrangement; setup timing is confirmed during planning.
availabilityNote: Final flowers are selected for freshness on the day; seasonal substitution of similar blooms and tones may apply.

title: Elevated Reception Centerpiece
summary: A raised centerpiece on a stand or vase for height and drama at receptions, custom designed on consultation.
descriptionHtml:
A tall, elevated centerpiece that lifts flowers above the table on a footed vessel or stand, drawing the eye upward and keeping the tabletop clear for place settings. We build height with structured focal blooms and cascading greenery for a dramatic, editorial presence across the room.

Available in Classic and Grand proportions. During your consultation we confirm the height, stand and palette so the arrangement suits the ceiling, the space and the rest of your styling.

  • Style: Raised, cascading arrangement on a stand or footed vessel
  • Sizes: Classic and Grand
  • Best for: Statement guest tables, entrances, focal moments
  • Care: Position on a stable, level surface away from direct sun
seoDescription: Tall elevated wedding centerpieces in Classic and Grand sizes for receptions in Kingston, Jamaica. Height and palette designed on consultation.
careInstructions: Set the arrangement on a stable, level surface out of direct sun and top up the water reservoir before guests are seated.
deliveryNote: Reception flowers are delivered and set to your venue by arrangement; setup timing is confirmed during planning.
availabilityNote: Final flowers are selected for freshness on the day; seasonal substitution of similar blooms and tones may apply.

title: Ceremony Aisle & Arch Arrangement
summary: Floral pieces for aisle ends, arches and altars, designed and scaled to your ceremony space on consultation.
descriptionHtml:
Floral work for the ceremony itself, covering aisle-end markers, arch and altar arrangements that frame the couple as they say their vows. We design each piece to the structure and the setting, whether a garden arch, a chuppah or a hotel ballroom, so the flowers feel built for the space rather than placed in it.

Scope, quantity and mounting are confirmed during planning. We tailor the scale and palette to your venue, then coordinate installation and any repurposing to the reception where possible.

  • Includes: Aisle markers, arch and altar florals to scope
  • Style: Designed to your structure and setting
  • Best for: Ceremony framing and processional
  • Care: Installed on site; kept shaded until the ceremony
seoDescription: Aisle, arch and altar wedding flowers in Kingston, Jamaica, designed and scaled to your ceremony space on consultation.
careInstructions: Ceremony pieces are installed on site and kept shaded and hydrated until the processional begins.
deliveryNote: Ceremony flowers are delivered and installed on site by arrangement; access and setup timing are confirmed during planning.
availabilityNote: Final flowers are selected for freshness on the day; seasonal substitution of similar blooms and tones may apply.
confirmationRequired: arch or structure dimensions and venue access

title: Sweetheart Table Arrangement
summary: A lush arrangement or garland for the couple's sweetheart or head table, custom designed on consultation.
descriptionHtml:
A generous floral treatment for the couple's sweetheart or head table, designed as the visual anchor of the reception. We build it as a lush front-facing arrangement or a flowing table garland, styled to draw the eye and photograph beautifully behind the couple.

Length, form and palette are agreed during planning so the piece fits the table and ties back to your bouquets and centerpieces. Where the layout allows, we can carry the design through from a ceremony arch to reduce waste.

  • Options: Front-facing arrangement or table garland
  • Style: Lush and abundant, tied to your palette
  • Best for: Sweetheart and head tables
  • Care: Kept cool until setup; misted lightly in warm rooms
seoDescription: Sweetheart and head table wedding flowers in Kingston, Jamaica, as a lush arrangement or garland, custom designed on consultation.
careInstructions: Keep the arrangement cool until setup, position it out of direct sun and mist lightly in warm rooms.
deliveryNote: Reception flowers are delivered and set to your venue by arrangement; setup timing is confirmed during planning.
availabilityNote: Final flowers are selected for freshness on the day; seasonal substitution of similar blooms and tones may apply.

title: Intimate Wedding Flower Package
summary: A starting flower package for intimate weddings: bridal and bridesmaid bouquets plus a few centerpieces, customised on consultation.
descriptionHtml:
A curated starting package for intimate weddings and elopements, bringing the essentials together in one coordinated palette. As a base it includes a bridal bouquet, a bridesmaid bouquet and a small set of low reception centerpieces, all designed to work as one considered look.

Think of this as a foundation rather than a fixed list. During your consultation we adjust the mix, quantities and palette to your guest count and venue, adding ceremony or table pieces as needed. Not just flowers, whatever it takes.

  • Base includes: Bridal bouquet, bridesmaid bouquet and a few low centerpieces
  • Style: One coordinated palette across every piece
  • Best for: Intimate weddings and elopements
  • Customised: Mix and quantities finalised on consultation
seoDescription: A starting wedding flower package for intimate ceremonies in Kingston, Jamaica: bouquets and centerpieces, customised on consultation.
careInstructions: Keep bouquets and centerpieces cool and hydrated until they are needed, and top up centerpiece water before the reception.
deliveryNote: Package flowers are delivered and set to your venue by arrangement; delivery and setup timing are confirmed during planning.
availabilityNote: Final flowers are selected for freshness on the day; seasonal substitution of similar blooms and tones may apply.
